skill_name: Analyze the given story and tell me what kind of positive attributes it carries.
workflow: The story of Alice carries positive attributes such as resilience, determination, self-discovery and courage. Alice faces the challenge of breaking away from her conservative and controlling parents and finds the strength to become independent and discover her true self. This story conveys the message of self-empowerment and encourages readers to have the courage to overcome difficult barriers and be true to themselves.
